desc: Derive the unordered rooted-forest characterization and recurrence: answer is the product over all nodes (including virtual root) of degree! divided by factorials of multiplicities of equal unordered child types.
Implement parse-tree construction, bottom-up order-insensitive canonical IDs, and modular multinomial product; run sample tests and edge-case checks.
Provide the final Python solution with correctness proof and complexity analysis.
